description:
Thursday, May 11, 2023
7pm EST | 4pm PSTShow more VSRF Founder Steve Kirsch talks with Special Guest Sasha Latypova. Ms. Latypova is a former pharmaceutical industry research & development executive with over 25 years of experience in clinical trials, clinical technologies, and regulatory approvals. She owned and managed several contract research organizations and worked for more than 60 pharma companies worldwide. As part of a scientific industry consortium on improving cardiac safety assessments in clinical trials, she even interacted with the FDA. During the show, Sasha discusses her expert opinion, based on observed evidence, that the Covid-19 “vaccine” originated as a bioweapon in answer to the virus, also a bioweapon. But she won’t just be focusing on the Chinese People’s Liberation Army as a source of these weapons – Sasha explores the alleged role of the U.S. Department of Defense in the creation of Covid (the Sars-CoV-2 virus and the Covid mRNA injections).
